'''Eric Lamont Dawson''' (born July 7, 1984) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for [[McLennan Community College|McLennan CC]] and [[Midwestern State Mustangs|Midwestern State]].

==College career==
Dawson spent two years at [[McLennan Community College]] before transferring to [[Midwestern State Mustangs|Midwestern State]] where he averaged 16.6 points and 10.6 rebounds in two seasons and earning All-LSC first-team honors in both seasons. He also was a Basketball Times second-team All American while helping the Mustangs to a conference title and an NCAA regional appearance in his senior season.<ref name="Reed">{{cite web|first=Trey|last=Reed|url=http://www.msumustangs.com/news/2016/9/26/mens-basketball-msu-former-standout-signs-free-agent-deal-with-utah-jazz.aspx|title=Former MSU standout signs free agent deal with Utah Jazz|work=MSUMustangs.com|date=September 26, 2016|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref>

==Professional career==
After going undrafted in the [[2007 NBA draft]], Dawson signed with the [[Austin Spurs|Austin Toros]] of the [[NBA Development League]] on November 1, 2007.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/d-league-draft-and-training-camp-rosters-complete/n-3555030|title=D-League Draft and Training Camp Rosters Complete|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 1, 2007|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref> On February 4, 2008, he was waived by the Toros after playing two games in an injury plagued.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/toros-acquire-serge-angounou/n-3588811|title=Toros Acquire Serge Angounou|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=February 4, 2008|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref> Afterwards, he signed with Marineros of Dominican Republic for the rest of the season.<ref name="Metros">{{cite web|first=Frank|last=Brito|url=http://www.melvynlopez.com/2013/07/metros-de-santiago-firman-eric-dawson.html|title=METROS DE SANTIAGO FIRMAN A ERIC DAWSON EN LUGAR DE JAMELLE HORNE|work=MelvynLopez.com|date=July 30, 2013|accessdate=October 15, 2016|language=Spanish|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161018213254/http://www.melvynlopez.com/2013/07/metros-de-santiago-firman-eric-dawson.html|archive-date=October 18, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On November 6, 2008, Dawson re-signed with the Austin Toros.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/toros-announce-returning-and-allocated-players/n-3736986|title=Toros Announce Returning and Allocated Players|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 6, 2008|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref> In 30 games, he averaged 10.3 points, 6.6 rebounds, 1.6 assists, 1.1 steals and one block in 24.2 minutes.<ref name="RealGM">{{cite web|url=http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Eric-Dawson/Summary/1761|title=Eric Dawson – RealGM|work=RealGM.com|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref> The next season, he played in Japan for [[Mitsubishi Diamond Dolphins]].

In December, 2010, Dawson re-signed with Austin.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/toros-fall-to-utah-flash/n-4124813|title=Toros Fall to Utah Flash|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=December 5, 2010|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref>

In 29 games with the Austin Toros in the 2011–12 season, Dawson averaged 17.2 points and 10.7 rebounds, shooting 56 percent from the field earning himself the [[NBA D-League]]'s Impact Player of the Year. He eclipsed previous career highs that he set in the 2008–09 season when he averaged 10.4 points and 6.6 rebounds. With Dawson in the lineup, the Toros put together a record of 19–10, helping them to the league's second best record at 33–17 going into the 2012 NBA D-League Playoffs.<ref>{{cite news|title=Austin's Eric Dawson Earns 2012 NBA D-League Impact Player of the Year Award |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/dawson_named_impact_poy_2012_04_19.html |work=NBA.com |publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc. |date=April 19, 2012 |accessdate=April 19, 2012 |url-status=bot: unknown |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151212034612/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/dawson_named_impact_poy_2012_04_19.html |archivedate=December 12, 2015 }}</ref>

During the [[2011–12 NBA season|2011–12 season]], he played two stints with the [[San Antonio Spurs]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA).<ref>{{cite news|title=Spurs Sign Eric Dawson to 10-Day Contract|url=http://www.nba.com/spurs/news/120220_spurs_sign_eric_dawson|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=February 20, 2012|accessdate=March 27, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Spurs Sign Eric Dawson to Second 10-Day Contract|url=http://www.nba.com/spurs/news/120316_dawson|work=NBA.com|publisher=Turner Sports Interactive, Inc.|date=March 16, 2012|accessdate=March 27, 2012}}</ref>

The [[Meralco Bolts]] of the [[Philippine Basketball Association]] selected Dawson as an import for the 2013 Commissioner's Cup.<ref>{{cite web|author=Team Meralco Bolts|title=Our import Eric Dawson set to arrive on January...|url=https://twitter.com/BansangMeralco/status/286093858771722240|work=Twitter.com|date=January 1, 2013|accessdate=January 1, 2013}}</ref> In July 2013, he signed with [[Metros de Santiago]] of the [[Dominican Republic]].<ref name="Metros" />

In June 2013, Dawson joined the [[Atlanta Hawks]] for the [[2013 NBA Summer League]] and on September 30, 2013, he signed with the Hawks.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14381|title=Atlanta Hawks fill up their training camp roster|work=InsideHoops.com|date=September 30, 2013|accessdate=September 30, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131015214846/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14381|archive-date=October 15, 2013|url-status=dead}}</ref> However, he was waived on October 26 after appearing in three preseason games.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14660|title=Atlanta Hawks waive forward Eric Dawson|work=InsideHoops.com|date=October 26, 2013|accessdate=October 26, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141006072552/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=14660|archive-date=October 6, 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref> On October 31, 2013, Dawson was re-acquired by the Austin Toros<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/austin/austin_toros_announce_trainig__2013_10_31.html |title=Austin Toros Announce Training Camp Invitees |work=NBA.com |date=October 31, 2013 |accessdate=October 31, 2013 |url-status=bot: unknown |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160110063045/http://www.nba.com/dleague/austin/austin_toros_announce_trainig__2013_10_31.html |archivedate=January 10, 2016 }}</ref> and averaged 14 points and 9.8 rebounds per game.<ref name="China">{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/117968/eric-dawson-signs-with-heilongjiang-zhaozhou-feng-shen.html|title=Eric Dawson signs with Heilongjiang Zhaozhou Feng Shen|work=Sportando.com|date=April 24, 2014|accessdate=April 24, 2014}}</ref> In March, 2013, Dawson signed with [[Petrochimi Bandar Imam BC|Petrochimi Bandar Imam]] to play in the final of the WABA League. He was the leading scorer for Petrochimi with 21 points, but lost the title.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/113916/mahram-tehran-won-the-waba-league.html|title=Mahram Tehran won the WABA League|work=Sportando.com|date=March 15, 2013|accessdate=March 15, 2013}}</ref> On April 24, 2014, Dawson signed with Heilongjiang Fengshen of the Chinese [[National Basketball League (China)|NBL]]<ref name="China" /> where he averaged 32 points, 15.7 rebounds and 3.3 steals per game.<ref name="Chalon">{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/130447/elan-chalon-announces-eric-dawson.html|title=Elan Chalon announces Eric Dawson|work=Sportando.com|date=August 6, 2014|accessdate=August 6, 2014}}</ref>

In June 2014, Dawson re-joined joining the Atlanta Hawks for the [[2014 NBA Summer League]]. On August 6, 2014, Dawson signed with [[Élan Chalon]] of France for the 2014–15 season.<ref name="Chalon" /> He averaged 11 points and 10 rebounds per game.<ref name="ParisL">{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/france/175800/eric-dawson-signs-with-paris-levallois.html|title=Eric Dawson signs with Paris-Levallois|work=Sportando.com|date=September 14, 2015|accessdate=September 14, 2015}}</ref> On June 16, 2015, he signed with the [[Leones de Ponce (basketball)|Leones de Ponce]] of Puerto Rico for the rest of the 2015 [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional|BSN]] season.<ref>{{cite web|first=Luis|last=Modestti|url=https://twitter.com/lmodestti/status/610538583104061440|title=#BSN Leones anuncian a Eric Dawson como su...|work=Twitter.com|date=June 15, 2015|accessdate=October 15, 2016|language=Spanish}}</ref> In 11 games, he averaged 8.5 points, 7.3 rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block.<ref name="RealGM" />

On September 14, 2015, Dawson signed with [[Paris-Levallois Basket|Paris-Levallois]] for the 2015–16 season.<ref name="ParisL" /> He averaged 10.8 points, 6.4 rebounds and 2.4 assists with Paris.<ref name="Dy">{{cite web|first=Richard|last=Dy|url=http://www.foxsportsasia.com/news/blackwater-taps-ex-meralco-import-eric-dawson/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161019061853/http://www.foxsportsasia.com/news/blackwater-taps-ex-meralco-import-eric-dawson/|url-status=dead|archive-date=October 19, 2016|title=Blackwater taps ex-Meralco import Eric Dawson|work=FoxSportsAsia.com|date=May 30, 2016|accessdate=October 15, 2016}}</ref> On May 30, 2016, he signed with [[Blackwater Elite]] for the [[2016 PBA Governors' Cup]].<ref name="Dy" /> In six games, he averaged 18.2 points, 15.2 rebounds, 4.7 assists, 2.3 steals and 2.2 blocks in 38.8 minutes per game.<ref name="Utah">{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/jazz/news/jazz-sign-free-agent-eric-dawson|title=Jazz Sign Free Agent Eric Dawson|work=NBA.com|date=September 23, 2016|accessdate=September 23, 2016}}</ref>

On September 23, 2016, Dawson signed with the [[Utah Jazz]],<ref name="Reed" /><ref name="Utah" /> but was later waived on October 13 after appearing in one preseason game.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/jazz/news/jazz-waive-dawson-ford-and-paige|title=Jazz Waive Dawson, Ford and Paige|work=NBA.com|date=October 13, 2016|accessdate=October 13, 2016}}</ref> On October 31, he was acquired by the [[Salt Lake City Stars]] of the [[NBA Development League]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.slcdunk.com/2016/10/31/13478502/nba-development-league-utah-jazz-salt-lake-city-stars-jaylen-bland-carl-ona-embo-jarelle-reischel|title=Salt Lake City Stars roster and info after D-League Draft|work=SLCDunk.com|publisher=SB-Nation|date=October 31, 2016|accessdate=November 5, 2016}}</ref> On November 26, he was waived by the Stars after suffering a foot injury. He averaged 6.5 points and 10.0 rebounds in 25 minutes.<ref>{{cite web|first=Hayley|last=Byrnes|url=http://saltlakecity.dleague.nba.com/news/salt-lake-city-stars-acquire-michale-kyser/|title=Salt Lake City Stars Acquire Michale Kyser|work=NBA.com|date=November 26, 2016|accessdate=December 3, 2016|archive-date=December 3, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203065011/http://saltlakecity.dleague.nba.com/news/salt-lake-city-stars-acquire-michale-kyser/|url-status=dead}}</ref> On January 4, 2017, he re-signed with Leones de Ponce.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.elnuevodia.com/deportes/baloncesto/nota/leonesdeponceanadenmaspoderparalaligadelasamericas-2277973/|title=Leones de Ponce añaden más poder para la Liga de las Américas|work=ElNuevoDia.com|date=January 4, 2017|accessdate=January 9, 2017|language=Spanish}}</ref>

On December 27, 2017, Dawson signed with [[Club Comunicaciones (Mercedes)|Comunicaciones]] of the Argentinian [[Liga Nacional de Básquet|LNB]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://balonalaire.com/2017/12/27/eric-dawson-se-suma-a-comunicaciones/|title=Eric Dawson se suma a Comunicaciones|work=BalonAlAire.com|date=December 27, 2017|accessdate=May 15, 2018|language=Spanish}}</ref> averaging 16 points, 13.3 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 1.9 steals in 23 games.<ref name="Cariduros">{{cite web|url=http://www.latinbasket.com/Puerto%20Rico/news/532274/Fajardo-tabs-Eric-Dawson,-ex-Comunicaciones|title=Fajardo tabs Eric Dawson, ex Comunicaciones|work=LatinBasket.com|date=May 13, 2018|accessdate=May 15, 2018}}</ref> On May 13, 2018, he returned to Puerto Rico, this time with [[Cariduros de Fajardo]].<ref name="Cariduros" />

In June 2020. Dawson signs for Mineros de Zacatecas of the Mexican league. <ref name="El Sol de Zacatecas (Spanish)">{{cite web|url=https://www.elsoldezacatecas.com.mx/deportes/mineros-de-zacatecas-le-da-la-bienvenida-a-eric-dawson-basquetbol-liga-nacional-de-balocesto-profesional-lnbp-defensor-sporting-club-5321028.html|title= Mineros de Zacatecas le da la bienvenida a Eric Dawson|work=El Sol de Zacatecas|date=June 5, 2020|accessdate=May 15, 2020}}</ref>
